WITH slc AS (
  SELECT
    sl.period,
    c.channel,
    SUM(sl.qty) AS qty,
    SUM(sl.revenue_cad) AS revenue
  FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line sl
  JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.customer c ON sl.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE sl.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
  GROUP BY sl.period, c.channel
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    period,
    SUM(qty) AS total_qty,
    SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue
  FROM slc
  GROUP BY period
)
SELECT
  s.period,
  s.channel,
  s.qty,
  s.revenue,
  t.total_qty,
  t.total_revenue,
  s.qty / t.total_qty AS qty_share,
  s.revenue / t.total_revenue AS rev_share
FROM slc s
JOIN totals t ON s.period = t.period
ORDER BY s.period, s.channel
